svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a strip 22 wide x 69 long. Fold 90 degrees at 20 and 49 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to make a U: back 29 tall, two arms 20 deep.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill one 8.5 mm hole through both arms, 17 from the outside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the back, on the centre line (drill the arms together).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 4.5 mm holes in the back, 8 from each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: back flat on the plate's inner face, 60 each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre, from 50 to 79 up; M4 screws into the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 22 x 23 mm roller goes between the arms on an M8 bolt,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the roller turns freely and stands 6 mm off the plate.
